+# Hosted data retention
+
+This is the proposed hosted v1 retention schedule. Deployment configuration
+must enforce these limits before launch.
+
+| Data | Default retention | Deletion trigger |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| Temporary repository clones | Job duration, no more than 24 hours | Job completion or failure cleanup |
+| Indexed code chunks and symbol graph | While installation has repository access, then 30 days | Repository access revoked or installation deleted |
+| Review reports and findings | 90 days | Expiry or installation-owner request |
+| Delivery and audit metadata | 180 days | Expiry, subject to security/legal preservation |
+| Application logs | 30 days | Rolling expiry |
+| Encrypted installation credentials | While installation is active | Installation deletion or token revocation |
+
+Uninstalling the GitHub App or revoking an installation starts a tenant-wide
+deletion window: all repository content, indexes, review artifacts, findings,
+credentials, and ordinary logs for that installation are deleted within 30
+days, even when their normal active-installation retention period is longer.
+
+Backups must age out deleted records within 35 additional days. Deletion jobs
+must be tenant-scoped, idempotent, observable, and tested. Security incidents or
+legal obligations may require a documented temporary preservation hold.
+
+The free GitHub Action runs in the user's GitHub Actions environment. Its
+artifacts follow the retention settings of that repository and GitHub account.

+# Install the hosted GitHub App
+
+The hosted px1 service is planned for v1. It is not required to use the free,
+accountless GitHub Action.
+
+## Installation flow
+
+1. Install the px1 GitHub App on an organization or personal account.
+2. Grant access only to the repositories that px1 should review.
+3. Open or update a pull request. px1 indexes the selected repository and
+   publishes its review as a draft so a human can inspect it before submission.
+4. Use `/px1 review` to request a fresh review or `/px1 explain` to ask for an
+   explanation on the current pull request revision.
+
+The App requests repository metadata and contents, pull-request read/write,
+and checks read access. It does not merge code or submit an approval. Reviewers
+remain responsible for reading the changed code and making the GitHub decision.
+
+Repository indexing is asynchronous. Large repositories may show an indexing
+status before their first review is ready. Reinstalling or changing repository
+access queues a fresh index for affected repositories.
+
+For self-hosted generation without an account, use the [free Action](../action.yml)
+and follow the setup in the main README.

+# Privacy policy
+
+This document describes the intended hosted px1 v1 data practices. It is a
+launch draft and must be completed with the operating legal entity, contact
+address, subprocessors, and effective date before public signup is enabled.
+
+## Data px1 processes
+
+When an authorized GitHub App installation requests a review, px1 processes
+repository metadata, source code needed for indexing, pull-request diffs,
+configured rules, review findings, and delivery metadata. Authentication tokens
+are encrypted at rest and are not included in model prompts.
+
+Optional AI analysis sends the minimum relevant code context to the configured
+model provider after secret and sensitive-data checks. The product must identify
+the provider and its retention terms before enabling this feature in production.
+
+## Access and isolation
+
+Access is limited to repositories selected during GitHub App installation.
+Stored repository data is associated with an installation tenant, and service
+queries enforce that tenant boundary. px1 employees and operators access private
+repository data only for documented support, security, or reliability needs.
+
+## Retention and deletion
+
+Repository clones and derived index data are removed after installation access
+is revoked or after the documented retention period. Uninstalling the App starts
+a 30-day deletion deadline for all hosted data associated with that installation,
+including review artifacts and findings. Logs and backups age out under the
+periods in [DATA_RETENTION.md](DATA_RETENTION.md). An installation owner may
+request deletion; production contact details must be published before launch.
+
+px1 does not sell repository code or use private repository code to train a
+general-purpose model.

+# Hosted service terms
+
+These are product terms for the planned hosted px1 v1 and are not a substitute
+for final legal review. The operating entity, governing law, support contact,
+effective date, and billing terms must be supplied before public launch.
+
+px1 provides review assistance, not a warranty that code is correct, secure, or
+fit for use. Automated findings and AI explanations can be incomplete or wrong.
+The user remains responsible for reading changes, protecting credentials,
+configuring repository access, and making merge and deployment decisions.
+
+Users must have authority to connect each repository and must not use px1 to
+process unlawful content, attack the service, bypass access controls, or violate
+third-party rights. px1 may suspend access needed to protect users or the service.
+
+The service may change during preview. Availability targets, paid-plan terms,
+liability limits, dispute terms, and termination rights require legal approval
+before a generally available paid service is offered.
+
+The free GitHub Action is distributed under the repository license and does not
+require a hosted px1 account.
